topic_title: 学位论文与长文档写作
domain: Actual supplied scientific source; local manuscript revision workflow

source.title: Strengthening of 3D Printed Fused Deposition Manufactured Parts Using the Fill Compositing Technique

task_instruction: 本案例用于“写作 16｜学位论文与长文档写作”。在长文档中保持跨章节结构、术语、引用和事实一致，并输出可控的章节级修改。 仅依据包内材料完成任务；材料未报告时明确说明，不能联网补写。 输出可编辑的目标产物、事实/证据映射、修改或生成记录和人工确认项；不得虚构材料外事实。 Execute the explicit public organizer-edit-workorder.json; it supplies the actual edit targets, minimal local workflow scope and required receipts. Full published scientific sources remain in scope for factual checks.

output_contract.deliverable: 可编辑的目标文稿/结构化产物
output_contract.preserved_facts: 数字、条件、术语和来源不可凭空改变
output_contract.evidence_map: 关键论断到来源定位的映射
output_contract.change_log: 修改动作、原因、人工确认项和未解决问题

evaluation: 固定输入；基础 Agent 与 Skill Agent 接收同一材料和任务；评分依据 reference-anchors.json 与题目评分项。

organizer_edit_workorder.authority: User-authorized organizer input repair; not source-owner approval
organizer_edit_workorder.task: Operate a real local revision workflow on the supplied manuscript. Add one substantive source-grounded editorial annotation at each target, explaining a scientific condition, limitation, or traceable clarification. Preserve original paragraph text, tables, formulas, citations, headings and all unrequested blocks. Use exact source quotations and state uncertainties.
operation_requirements: Propose and individually accept or reject changes
Real controlled invalid-operation exceptions with unchanged state
Editable manuscript, original/revised records, evidence map, real export preview
organizer_edit_workorder.consistency_scope: Inspect actual target chapters and related definitions/methods/results; record terminology, reference anchors, scientific conditions and unresolved source conflicts. A mechanical inventory alone is not scientific verification.
organizer_edit_workorder.boundaries: Minimal offline local CLI workflow is allowed by the original task. No private remote client, coauthor account or Word tracked-change XML is supplied or required. Invalid operations are labeled deliberate fault injections, not remote platform failures. Source-derived working chapters are not a completed degree thesis.
organizer_edit_workorder.source_fidelity: Original publication bytes and contradictory source statements remain unchanged. Clearly distinguish new editorial annotations from original research. Do not invent new experiments or correct ambiguous units silently.
